summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the redemption of its $1.5bn 5.985% Senior Callable Fixed-to-Fixed Rate Notes due 2027 and $500m Senior Callable Floating Rate Notes due 2027. The redemption will occur on August 7, 2026 at 100% of principal plus accrued interest, per the Indenture. This is a routine debt retirement under the issuer's call option, not a special situation. Listing on the NYSE will be cancelled. No shareholder involvement, premium, or strategic event. This is a standard capital management action, analogous to a US issuer's notice of redemption for outstanding notes.
